name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: International PhD students to face strict limits on time in the US
changes.summary: Nature, Published online: 23 July 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02280-3 Trump administration takes action to address ‘forever students’.

changes.title: Trump’s Global Tariffs: What’s the Latest on the Trade War
changes.summary: The president has unveiled a complicated system to forge ahead with his trade war, after the Supreme Court struck down his original levies.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: U.S.-Iran strikes escalate, affecting global energy markets, Trump imposes double-digit tariffs on dozens of countries, Vigil held in Madison, Wisconsin, for man killed by police.

changes.title: The Cost of Trump’s New Tariffs, and the $100 Million Popcorn Bucket Market
Iran War and Trump’s Tariffs Threaten a Resilient U.S. Economy
changes.summary: As renewed fighting with Iran sends oil and gas prices soaring, President Trump has imposed new global tariffs that could push up prices further.

changes.title: Concerns over U.S. weapons getting depleted as U.S. and Iran continue to trade strikes
changes.summary: As the U.S. builds up forces in the Middle East amid the ongoing war with Iran, there's concern among some officials that U.S. weapons may be getting depleted. It comes as President Trump has threatened new escalations and as the U.S. and Iran continue to trade strikes. Charlie D'Agata reports.

changes.title: Trump imposes new tariffs on dozens of countries, including U.S. allies
changes.summary: President Trump is imposing new tariffs on dozens of countries accused of failing to crack down on forced labor. The tariffs range from 10% to 12.5% and include U.S. allies. Nancy Cordes reports.

changes.title: Some Trump officials worried about rapid use of interceptor, precision-guided weapons, sources say
changes.summary: Some Trump administration officials are concerned about the rapid use of interceptor and precision-guided weapons in the Middle East, sources told CBS News. CBS News' Kathryn Watson has more.

changes.title: Why Trump’s Renewed Trade War Could Be Costly
changes.summary: Households and businesses were already contending with an affordability crunch. A new round of tariffs could inflict more pain.

changes.title: How Trump's threat of a "massive attack" on Iran could unfold
changes.summary: President Trump said he is considering a "massive attack" on Iran as fighting ramps up. CBS News' Charlie D'Agata explains how a U.S. military attack on Iran could unfold.
